messages:
anya: Quick onboarding snag — Next edge sample types error on `client.request()`; TS infers `any` even though we export generic signatures.
pat: Are you importing top-level or /edge? edge bundlers can pick commonjs fallback if exports not set.
jordan: Also confirm tsconfig moduleResolution; `nodenext` tends to match bundlers for ESM builds.
anya: I tried nodenext; types got better but still picked the non-generic overload. Any ideas on typing ordering?
pat: We had this before — TS prefers specific overloads over generic ones. Reorder so generic is last or add `generate<T = unknown>(...): Promise<T>` fallback.
ci-bot: ci: added `samples-edge-types` job to run TS on the sample with node/nodenext matrix (queued).
